instruction: Export the receipt image OIP.jpg from /home/user as a PDF document. Name it "payment_record.pdf" and save it to the Desktop folder.

metadata.explanation: Task converts OIP.jpg to PDF as 'payment_record.pdf' on Desktop. Evaluator verifies /home/user/Desktop/payment_record.pdf has 1 page, size > 10KB, and image content.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: file exists at correct path (/home/user/Desktop/payment_record.pdf), has exactly 1 page, and contains actual image content
Getter logic (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the PDF file from VM to local cache, with proper error handling for missing files

Metric logic (check_pdf_pages__f953191d) comprehensively verifies: page count matches expected value (1), file size > 10KB to prevent empty/corrupt files, and PDF contains images via XObject inspection
verify_content flag ensures image conversion quality - checks both file size and presence of image objects in PDF structure
Appropriate postconfig (2-second sleep) allows file system state to stabilize after save operation
Edge cases properly handled: missing file returns 0.0, corrupt/empty PDFs caught by size check, PDFs without images detected
Expected values are semantically correct: ref_value=1 for single-image conversion, verify_content=true for quality assurance

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_pdf_pages__f953191d first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
